game.title: Deleted Wiki: Clean Up the Lost Files

roadmap.title: Early game: first folders, scripts and secrets
roadmap.description: Open the browser's Help menu for Rookery Build before the first stage ends. Restore your first Category folder before installing PlacementCheck or FolderSort. Sort the first items, read the About page, answer the scam message, and try the six-wrong-drops trick on one item.

roadmap.title: Main run: empty the deletion log
roadmap.description: Keep sorting until all seven Category folders and the log are done. Buy and upgrade every script as you go, and use the power-ups for the five-minute Minor Edit run.

roadmap.title: After the main game: Nullbane mode and reading
roadmap.description: Open the featured articles from the Home page. Play the secret Nullbane mode, empty the wiki, edit the homepage founder line, then recheck the User Talk page and newsletter.

achievements.description: You put the first entry back.
achievements.summary: Put the first entry back from the Trash into a folder.

steps.text: Drag any item from the Trash onto a Category folder.

achievements.description: One percent of the deletion log worked through.
achievements.summary: Process 1% of the deletion log.

steps.text: Keep restoring items from the Trash until 1% of the deletion log is processed.

achievements.description: A tenth of the deletion log worked through.
achievements.summary: Process 10% of the deletion log.

steps.text: Keep restoring items from the Trash until 10% of the deletion log is processed.

achievements.description: A quarter of the deletion log worked through.
achievements.summary: Process 25% of the deletion log.

steps.text: Keep restoring items from the Trash until 25% of the deletion log is processed.

achievements.description: Half of the deletion log worked through.
achievements.summary: Process 50% of the deletion log.

steps.text: Keep restoring items from the Trash until 50% of the deletion log is processed.

achievements.description: Three quarters of the deletion log worked through.
achievements.summary: Process 75% of the deletion log.

steps.text: Keep restoring items from the Trash until 75% of the deletion log is processed.

achievements.description: The deletion log holds nothing at all.
achievements.summary: Empty the deletion log completely.

steps.text: Keep restoring items until the deletion log holds nothing.

achievements.description: One Category Folder is whole again.
achievements.summary: Fully restore one Category folder.

steps.text: Sort every item in one Category folder, for example Weapons, into its right Sub-Folders and Item Folders.

achievements.description: Four Category Folders restored.
achievements.summary: Fully restore four Category folders.

steps.text: Finish three more Category folders after your first.

achievements.description: All seven Category Folders restored.
achievements.summary: Fully restore all seven Category folders.

guide.context: The seven are Weapons, Armor, Consumables, Materials, Skills & Status, Interface and Curios, so sort whichever remain.

steps.text: Finish the last three Category folders.

achievements.description: Twenty-five entries sorted into the right Sub-Folder, one after another.
achievements.summary: Place 25 entries one after another into their right Sub-Folder with no wrong drop.

guide.context: A wrong drop ends the run, so go slowly.

steps.text: Drag items from the Trash one by one into the right Sub-Folder.
Keep going until you have 25 correct drops in a row.

achievements.description: One hundred entries sorted with zero misfiles.
achievements.summary: Place 100 entries into their right Sub-Folder without one wrong drop.

guide.context: A wrong drop ends the run and you start again.

steps.text: Pick items you can place with confidence.
Drop each into its right Sub-Folder until 100 are done with no wrong drop.

achievements.description: Fifty items in a row dragged to the right Sub-Folder or Item Folder without hovering to read one.
achievements.summary: Drop 50 items in a row into their correct Sub-Folder without hovering to read one.

guide.context: Only drops into a Sub-Folder count. Drops onto a Category folder or an Item Folder neither count nor end the run. Quitting the game clears the run.

steps.text: Drag one item at a time. Carrying a multi-selected stack ends the run.
Pick up and drop each item within about 2 seconds, so the hover tooltip never shows.
Use the item's picture to choose the Sub-Folder.
Keep going without a wrong drop until you reach 50, in one sitting.

achievements.description: A Category Folder restored with neither PlacementCheck nor FolderSort installed.
achievements.summary: Finish restoring one Category folder while PlacementCheck and FolderSort are both uninstalled.

guide.context: Do this early, before you install either script. All other scripts are allowed. FolderSort only unlocks once you have put one copy of each missing item into a single Sub-Folder, so avoid doing that until you finish.

steps.text: Do not install PlacementCheck or FolderSort.
Restore every item in one Category folder.
If you already installed one of them, start a new save profile.

achievements.description: A tenth of the deletion log routed out inside five minutes.
achievements.summary: Route a tenth of the deletion log out within five minutes.

guide.context: Use your strongest scripts, such as Multiselect, SortBot and AutoRestore. This also works in Hacker mode.

steps.text: Buy and upgrade your sorting scripts first.
Start a timer, then move items out of the log as fast as you can until a tenth is done within five minutes.

achievements.description: You installed your first script.
achievements.summary: Install your first script.

steps.text: Spend your points on any script from the script list.

achievements.description: Every script installed, every one at its highest version.
achievements.summary: Own all 12 scripts, each at its top upgrade level.

guide.context: There are 12 scripts, and some have several upgrade levels, such as Multiselect. Points only come from sorting, so buy every level as you go before the last items are sorted.

steps.text: Earn Sorting Points by sorting, and Completion Points by filling whole rows.
Install each script and buy every upgrade level.
Check that no script still shows a higher level to buy.

achievements.description: Install a script only purchasable with Completion Points
achievements.summary: Install a script that can only be bought with Completion Points.

steps.text: Fill a whole row in a Sub-Folder to earn a Completion Point.
Buy a script that costs Completion Points.

achievements.description: Read every message left on your talk page.
achievements.summary: Read every message on your User Talk page.

guide.context: New messages arrive as the story goes on, including after the main game and Nullbane mode, so check again at the end.

steps.text: Open the User Talk page and open each message.
After you finish Nullbane mode and the founder edit, open the page again and read any new messages.

achievements.description: Organize the last item deleted by the vandal.
achievements.summary: Organize the last item the vandal deleted.

steps.text: Restore the last item the vandal deleted.

achievements.description: Read the About page all the way to the bottom.
achievements.summary: Scroll the wiki's About page to its very end.

steps.text: Open the wiki's About page.
Scroll down until you reach the end.

achievements.description: Locate the single wiki page that was spared.
achievements.summary: Open the Tanager page, the only page left untouched by the wipe.

steps.text: Open Help, then About, and scroll to the credits at the bottom.
Click Tanager.

achievements.description: Read every issue of the newsletter.
achievements.summary: Read every issue of the newsletter.

guide.context: Open each issue itself, not only the message that announces it. New issues also arrive late in the game.

steps.text: Look for newsletter issues in the wiki's links and in your User Talk messages.
Open each one, and check again after Nullbane mode.

achievements.description: Read every featured article.
achievements.summary: Read every featured article.

guide.context: These pages look like ordinary wiki pages and are separate from the newsletter. Do this after the main game, once every item is put away.

steps.text: Press Home on the wiki, then scroll down to Featured articles.
Open each linked article, go back, and open the next.

achievements.description: Verify your account from the suspicion notice.
achievements.summary: Submit the account verification form from the scam message.

guide.context: The message comes from PoEO_Account_Services and warns about an account suspension. It shows up early on User Talk.

steps.text: Open User Talk and the message dated 18 Mar 2007, 2:38 pm.
Click the link in the message.
Type anything in every box, then press verify my account.

achievements.description: Open the in-game browser's About box.
achievements.summary: Open the About box of the in-game browser.

guide.context: Do this early. The wiki About page does not count.

steps.text: In the browser menu bar at the top, open Help.
Click About Corvid Navigator 7.

achievements.description: Six wrong tries on one item, then the correct Sub-Folder.
achievements.summary: Drop one item into six incorrect Sub-Folders, then into its right Sub-Folder.

guide.context: Wrong drops that a script blocks may not count, so drag by hand.

steps.text: Pick one item.
Drop it into six different wrong Sub-Folders, taking it back out each time.
Drop it into the right Sub-Folder.

achievements.description: Clear the wiki after the game's main story.
achievements.summary: Clear every item from the wiki after finishing the main game.

guide.context: This comes with the secret Nullbane mode.

steps.text: Finish the main game.
Play Nullbane mode and delete every item until the wiki is empty.

achievements.description: Credit the founders on the homepage.
achievements.summary: Enter the correct founder's name on the wiki homepage.

steps.text: Finish Nullbane mode: delete every item and watch the cutscene.
Click Home, then the gold Edit Homepage button.
At the bottom, find the founder line where Wren's name is crossed out.
Type Robin in the box and submit.
